issues.title: bun add with no package.json installs nothing and reports success
issues.doing: Adding rack42u with bun add git+file://...#HEAD in an app folder that had no package.json (chat: cd chat && bun add ...; files: first in the trials folder, the shell cwd, then in files/)
issues.happened:
chat: Bun printed 'installed rack42u@git+file://...#7dc1aba... with binaries: rack' and '1 package installed', twice, but the folder had no package.json, bun.lock, or node_modules afterwards.
files: bun add printed 'installed rack42u@git+file:///home/zmmfly/prjs/rack42u#7dc1aba... with binaries: - rack' and done in 1 ms, but wrote no package.json or node_modules in files/. The first run was in the trials folder and changed that folder; undone with bun remove rack42u. Only after writing a package.json by hand did it install.
issues.expected: A package.json made in the app's folder, or an error; at least package.json, bun.lock and node_modules/rack42u to exist
issues.where: docs/getting-started.md 'Create the app' says to make package.json first, but the skill and the trials CLAUDE.md 'Adding rack42u' do not say it must exist before bun add, nor that the shell cwd is the trials folder and not the app's. Bun gave no warning.
issues.workaround: Wrote package.json by hand, ran bun install / cd <app> && bun add ..., pinned the commit by hand. Did not read source.

issues.title: Trial permissions deny the commands and files CLAUDE.md allows
issues.doing: Reading the skill in .claude/skills/rack42u and running bun, ls and cd from the app folder
issues.happened:
watcher: Bash(ls /home/zmmfly/prjs/rack42u/.agents/trials/.claude/skills/rack42u) and an earlier `cd ...; pwd; ls ...; cat watcher/SPEC.md` both returned: Permission to use Bash has been denied because Claude Code is running in don't ask mode. Read of .claude/skills/rack42u/SKILL.md returned the same denial. Read of watcher/SPEC.md succeeded. Nothing was built, no TRIAL.md written.
chat: Bash ls and Read on .claude/skills/rack42u were denied by the permission mode; the Skill tool loaded SKILL.md.
files: Read of .claude/skills/rack42u/SKILL.md and plain ls were denied; bun -e could list directories; some compound commands (cd dir; ls, $?, PIPESTATUS, a long bun -e script) were denied while cd dir && bun ... worked; bun add --cwd <dir> printed success but wrote nowhere.

issues.workaround: chat and files: Skill tool for the skill, cd <app> && bun ..., bun -e for listings, Edit/Write for files. watcher: none; stopped, no source read.

issues.title: list() and restore() socket shape of the HTTP handler is not documented
issues.doing: Broadcasting to the sockets of a room from a device behind the HTTP panel, and keeping them across a swap
issues.happened: docs/guides/http.md says to return handler.list() from snapshot, but not what it returns, nor that it can serve as room membership (the data given to upgrade() comes back in it). The API table only says 'A socket and its data'
issues.expected: The shape { socket: id, data }, and a note that a device can broadcast with ctx.emit.http.send({ socket: [ids], data })
issues.where: guides/http.md 'WebSocket' and reference/api.md HttpSocketState; a chat-like broadcast example is missing
issues.workaround: Read node_modules/rack42u/src/std/http.ts (HttpSocketState, HttpHandler); then used list() as the room membership and ctx.emit.http.send to broadcast

issues.title: The HTTP panel cannot send a large streamed file with Content-Length
issues.doing: Serving GET /files/<name> through the HTTP panel, with Content-Length and without holding 50 MiB in memory
issues.happened: http.md says a response body over httpHandler's streamThreshold (16 MiB) streams chunked without Content-Length even when the device names one; raising the threshold would hold the file in memory. Confirmed with plain Bun.serve that a ReadableStream response with explicit content-length also goes out chunked.
issues.expected: A way to send a large stored file through the panel with its length
issues.where: The HTTP panel (guides/http.md, Requests): no way to give a streamed or file-backed response a length. Listeners (guides/listeners.md) is the way out, but a length there needs new Response(Bun.file(path)), hence a file path.
issues.workaround: web device opens its own listener with ctx.serve(); store has a locate member that answers the file's path so web answers new Response(Bun.file(path)). Steps around the backplane; web must see the same disk. No source read.

sources.title: A 50 MiB download can have a Content-Length only from a listener of the device itself
